quarantine_disposition.scientific_reason: Bibliographic metadata fabrication, synthetic paragraph repetition (41-55x), mid-word passage cuts (75%), and unvalidated grammar rulepacks documented in DEF-DAT-01..06.
quarantine_disposition.immutability_mandate: Zero in-place modifications permitted on historical artifacts. Historical files remain permanently frozen and read-only for forensic auditability and historical replay tests.
quarantine_disposition.namespace_isolation: All V2 replacement tasks, fixtures, and execution ledgers shall reside strictly in isolated namespaces (services/generation-service/app/experiment/final_dataset_v2.py and generation_baseline/.execution/RQ2_V2/).

DEF-DAT-01.title: Bibliographic Metadata Fabrication in Policy Records
DEF-DAT-01.forensic_finding: 6 policy records mapped real medical PMCIDs (PMC8910001–PMC8910006) to fictitious authors, fabricated titles, and synthetic DOIs (e.g. PMC8910002 maps to trauma depression research in NCBI, but was labeled Mesopotamian irrigation in repository).

DEF-DAT-02.title: Synthetic Text Padding & Consecutive Paragraph Duplication
DEF-DAT-02.forensic_finding: Each of the 6 policy records duplicated paragraph 2 between 41 and 55 consecutive times to artificially inflate word count above 600 words.

DEF-DAT-03.title: Contaminated Reading Task Assembly from Padded Sources
DEF-DAT-03.forensic_finding: 12 of 28 Reading tasks (final-reading-017 to final-reading-028, 42.9% of reading benchmark) consumed padded texts; sections 2, 3, and 4 consist entirely of a single sentence repeated 11–14 times.

DEF-DAT-04.title: Mid-Word Passage Segmentation via Arbitrary Character Division
DEF-DAT-04.forensic_finding: Integer character division len(full_text) // 4 sliced text mid-word in 21 of 28 Reading tasks (75.0%), producing ungrammatical cut stems like 'classified a' and 'ibution networks'.

DEF-DAT-05.title: Arbitrary Grammar Difficulty Cycling & Mislabeling
DEF-DAT-05.forensic_finding: A modulo cycle ['B1', 'B2', 'C1'] forced high-complexity syntactic structures (Negative Inversion, Clefts) to be mislabeled as B1, and elementary passives as C1.

DEF-DAT-06.title: Synthetic Grammar Provenance & Example Starvation
DEF-DAT-06.forensic_finding: RulePacks declared license='synthetic_not_expert' without academic grammar citations, providing only 2 static examples per family, causing cross-arm prompt collapse.
